name: Order of Scribes
description: A wizard subclass that adds the Scribes tradition from Tasha's Cauldron of Everything.

grants.name: Awakened Spellbook
grants.description: Your spellbook becomes an Arcane Focus. When casting a Wizard spell with a slot, you can replace its damage type with one found in another spell of that level in the book; you can also cast Wizard rituals using their normal casting time.

grants.name: Wizardly Quill
grants.description: As a Bonus Action, create a magic quill that needs no ink, copies spells into your spellbook in two minutes per spell level, and can erase its own writing.

grants.name: Manifest Mind
grants.description: As a Bonus Action, manifest your spellbook's spectral mind within 60 feet. You perceive and cast Wizard spells from its space, with a limited number of remote casts per Long Rest.

grants.name: Master Scrivener
grants.description: After a Long Rest, create one temporary spell scroll containing a level 1 or 2 Wizard spell from your book. Only you can use it, and it casts one level higher.

grants.name: One with the Word
grants.description: Gain Advantage on Arcana checks while holding your awakened spellbook. Use your Reaction to prevent all damage to yourself, temporarily losing spells from the book whose combined levels equal a 3d6 roll. Once per Long Rest.
